scope: pilot comparison; official default is 50 trials per task
policy_seed_formula: 7 + suite_index * 10000 + task_id * 100 + trial_index; suite indices follow suites array
environment_seed_reset: numpy and env seed reset to 7 at the start of every episode for reproducible resume
error_handling: record error separately and stop evaluator; no silent error-to-policy-failure conversion
success_criterion: done returned by LIBERO BDDLBaseDomain.step(), assigned from self._check_success(); no external reward threshold
comparison_scope: two official LIBERO-adapted checkpoints; measured differences are not attributable solely to algorithm architecture or training method
paired_seed_limitation: identical per-episode seed values; pi0 horizon 50 versus pi05 horizon 10 means the sampled Gaussian tensors are not identical
method_notes: Each model keeps its official policy config, checkpoint normalization, and delta-action transform. The first five provided initial states are a pilot sample, not a random sample of all states.
